opening.argument: The speaker explains a named unit-linked insurance plan as combining investment with life cover, then discusses an approximate expected return, a monthly premium, a ten-year maturity value, and a five-year lock-in period. Those details are presented alongside advice to inspect charges and a warning that the company does not guarantee a definite return. This is an explanation of the plan's terms and risks, not a promise of a fixed outcome. The subscription requests concern channel engagement; they are not tied to joining the investment or to a required transfer of money or data.

citations.quote: this will be a Unit Linked Insurance Plan where the company will provide you with investment as well as life cover.
an approximate return you can expect will be between 14-16% if you are in an investment SBI life smart wealth builder plan.
And after 10 years I'll get my maturity value back.
If you make any investment, make sure to look at the charges.
